run_projection_cli: run the projector CLI to project a target image into the latent space of a pretrained StyleGAN2 network
project_image_to_latent: project a target image tensor to the W latent space of a pretrained generator using gradient descent
project_with_custom_steps: project an image using a custom number of optimization steps and learning rate schedule
save_projection_video: save an MP4 video showing the optimization progress of projecting a target image to latent space
load_and_project_image: load a target image, crop and resize it, then project it to the generator latent space
